evidence: Y2O3 thin films were grown onto Si(100) substrates by atomic layer deposition (ALD) using organometallic precursors, viz. tris(cyclopentadienyl)yttrium, Cp3Y, and tris(methylcyclopentadienyl)yttrium, (CpCH3)3Y (Cp ) cyclopentadienyl). Water was used as oxygen source. Nitrogen (>99.999%, Schmidlin UHPN 3000 N2 generator) was used as a carrier and purging gas.
